condition_specific: cancers affecting the skin, breasts, central nervous system or lymphatic, digestive, hematological, urinary, skeletal, oral, or reproductive systems
notes: Covers state, county, and municipal firefighters. Pre-employment exam must show no evidence of cancer. System-based cancer list (not specific cancer types): skin, breasts, CNS, lymphatic, digestive, hematological, urinary, skeletal, oral, reproductive systems. Tobacco exclusion: presumption for smoking/tobacco-caused cancers does not apply to any municipal fire fighter who smokes cigarettes or uses tobacco products after January 1, 2001. 'Municipal fire fighter' under this section includes persons under s. 61.66 whose duties as a firefighter during the 10-year qualifying period took up at least two-thirds of working hours.

Covers state, county, and municipal firefighters. Pre-employment exam must show no evidence of heart or respiratory impairment or disease. Presumption applies in proceedings for disability or death benefits under s. 40.65(2) or applicable pension/retirement systems. 'Municipal fire fighter' includes persons under s. 61.66 where firefighting duties took up at least two-thirds of working hours during the 5-year qualifying period.

Same statute and pre-employment exam requirement as cardiovascular row. Heart and respiratory impairment/disease are covered together under § 891.45(2). Covers state, county, and municipal firefighters.

condition_specific: HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, hepatitis A, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, hepatitis D, diphtheria, meningococcal meningitis, methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS)
notes: Pre-employment exam must show no evidence of an infectious disease. 'Fire fighter' for this section means a state, county, or municipal firefighter covered under § 891.45 and persons under s. 61.66 whose duties as a firefighter took up at least two-thirds of working hours. Presumption applies in proceedings for disability or death benefits.

condition_specific: Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD); workers' compensation presumption
notes: Wis. Stat. § 102.17(9). Enacted 2021 a. 29, effective April 29, 2021, for law enforcement officers and full-time firefighters. Expanded by 2025 a. 145, effective April 1, 2026, to include all firefighters regardless of full-time or volunteer status, as well as emergency medical responders (s. 256.01(4p)) and emergency medical services practitioners (s. 256.01(5)). The presumption is rebuttable by a preponderance of evidence. Benefits are capped at 32 calendar weeks per episode, with a lifetime cap of no more than 3 episodes per individual. Excluded causes: disciplinary actions, work evaluations, job transfers, layoffs, demotions, and terminations.
